NAME:
   rancher create machine-config - Create a machine config for the machine pool of a node-driver cluster

USAGE:
   rancher create machine-config [flags] <amazonec2config|azureconfig|digitaloceanconfig|harvesterconfig|vmwarevsphereconfig> <name>

FLAGS:
   --help, -h                               show help
   --image image                            digitaloceanconfig: droplet image slug
   --ipv6                                   digitaloceanconfig: enable IPv6 (omit to keep the driver default)
   --monitoring                             digitaloceanconfig: enable monitoring (omit to keep the driver default)
   --private-networking                     digitaloceanconfig: enable private networking (omit to keep the driver default)
   --region region                          digitaloceanconfig: droplet region slug (e.g. nyc3)
   --set field=value [ --set field=value ]  driver field=value; repeat the flag for more fields. Values such as true and ["a"] are read as JSON; numbers and other values are sent as strings (Rancher's schema types numeric driver fields as strings)
   --size size                              digitaloceanconfig: droplet size slug (e.g. s-2vcpu-4gb)
   --tags tags                              digitaloceanconfig: comma-separated droplet tags

GLOBAL FLAGS:
   --allow-deprecated          allow writing to a deprecated resource
   --apply                     apply the change
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --dry-run                   preview the changes without applying them
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
   --yes                       confirm a destructive change
